ruleDefinitions.name: Java Running with Remote Debugging
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a JAVA process running with remote debugging allowing more than just localhost to connect

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*transport\\=dt\\_socket\\,address\\=.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*jre1\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*jdk1\\\..*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*address\\=127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*address\\=localhost.*")))
